content: शान्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [शम्-क्त] .²1 Appeased, allayed, calmed, satisfied, pacified; चचार सानुजः शान्तो वृद्धेक्ष्वाकुव्रतं युवा <ls>R. 12. 20</ls>. .²2 Cured, alleviated; शान्तरोगः. .²3 Abated, subsided, put an end to, removed, extinguished; शान्तरथक्षोभपरिश्रमम् <ls>R. 1. 58</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 47</ls>; शान्तार्चिषं दीपमिव प्रकाशः <ls>Ki. 17. 16</ls>. .²4 Ceased, stopped; शान्तमृगप्रचारम् <ls>Ku. 3. 42</ls>. .²5 Dead, deceased; तेषु सर्वेषु शान्तेषु गतेष्वविदितां गतिम्. .²6 Stilled, hushed. .²7 Calm, quiet, undisturbed, tranquil, still; शान्तमिदमाश्रमपदम् <ls>Ś. 1. 16</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">4. 19</ls>. .²8 Tamed; स्वमाश्रमं शान्तमृगं निनाय <ls>R. 14. 79</ls>. .²9 Free from passions, at ease, contented; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 4. 4. 23</ls>. .²10 Shaded. .²11 Gentle; शान्तानुकूलपवनश्च शिवश्च पन्थाः <ls>Ś. 4. 11</ls>. .²12 Purified. .²13 Meek, humble. .²14 Auspicious (in augury); (the phrase शान्तं पापम् which is sometimes repeated, means ‘oh no!’, ‘how can it be’, ‘God forbid such an untoward or unlucky event’; <ls>Ś. 5</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1</ls>). .²15 Rendered ineffective, harmless (said of weapons). .{@-न्तः@} .²1 A man who has subdued his passions, an ascetic. .²2 Tranquillity, quietism, the sentiment of quietism, the predominant feeling of which is indifference to worldly objects and pleasures; see निर्वेद and रस. .{@-न्तम्@} Appeasing, pacifying. .{@-न्तम्@} {%ind.%} Enough, no more, not so, for shame, hush!, god (heaven) forbid!; शान्तं कथं दुर्जनाः पौरजानपदाः <ls>U. 1</ls>; तामेव शान्तमथवा किमिहोत्तरेण <ls n="U.">3. 26</ls>.
